review_text: We visited Paramount Coffee while traveling to Davao, and their drinks were amazing! Super smooth and full of flavor. It's a great spot to take a break and relax. If you're a coffee lover visiting the area, this place is a must-try! Loved their cake too!
A good place to drink coffee with your friends or barkadas. A lot of available tables that you can stay and relax. you can also take nice and cute pictures for your social media account

The location of the coffee shop is so nice! Perfect for catch up with friends or date with your partner!! ♥️ The pizza is also delicious, but the fries is just the normal fries we can make on our own. They also make great coffees ☕️

Love it here. The place is so big its certainly nice for big gatherings. Its not crowded. Its nicer in the evening as long as it doesn't rain coz then, you'll probably dripping wet specially if it happens to be crowded.. Haven't tried seeing the place in daylight with the scorching sun.. Its open, so I can only imagine how hot could that be.. The food I wished there were more varieties to choose from.. But overall, I loved the place ✨

Spacious and airy ang ambiance sa place. You can sit outside. And enjoy the night breeze of crocodile park. Best if night time mag visit but they close at around 10pm. There's also eatery beside it so pwede ra kaayo mag kaon sag meal then coffee afterwards. We got matcha latter which is not too sweet and hibiscus tea. Refreshing after meal al fresco style. They have plenty of parking spaces as well.
Their indoor seating can only accommodate a few groups (around 2-3), but they have a huge alfresco dining which are shared w the other restaurants around. The drinks were okay, nothing too fancy.
A nice cafe that is mainly situated outdoors. Since there is no AC, it can be very hot. Besides this, it's a very nice place with a great atmosphere. There are many drink options and they're tasty!

It was my first time going to this place. The place was nice, neat and clean. The ambiance is perfect different gatherings. The place is safe and good place to chill out. The food is awesome. The French fries (chips) both sour cream and cheese flavour worth recommending, a must try.

One of the best coffee shop in Davao. Legit 💯 Fave drink Iced Spanish latte sub oat and for the food Triple Chocolate Revel Bar. Tried their cake (forgot the name) yummy din naman. We went there recently (March 2) I hope ibalik nila yung old Triple Chocolate Revel Bar na taste huhu yummy naman yung ngayon pero mas yummy yung dati..

Being a coffee enthusiast, my goal is to sample every Spanish latte and Spanish cold brew in town. So, I decided to go for Paramount's 16 oz drink along with a revel bar. I found their Spanish latte to be exceptionally sweet, to the point where the coffee flavor wasn't very pronounced. The revel bar was decent, though. What I truly enjoyed about the place is its outdoor setting!

Located within the scenic Riverfront Corporate City inside the Davao Crocodile Park complex, Paramount Coffee is a relaxing cafe spot known for its Instagram-worthy industrial ambiance and outdoor seating. It specializes in locally sourced Mindanao coffee—particularly Arabica beans from Mt. Apo—offering a "seed-to-cup" experience that includes pour-overs, signature lattes, and occasionally, rare Civet coffee. It is a popular spot for visitors to unwind after touring the zoo or to enjoy a casual meal amidst the greenery of the park.
